log.msg: lesson: the one-wire seam held with THREE consumers unchanged - changed(predicate) fires from set()/query() only, dashboard's refresh(predicate) is the only code that knows three regions exist. Typing tr narrowed stat count + wall + table to the same 3 rows in one keystroke (verified: shown read "3"); clicking the ux segment read "6". Filter.js needed zero changes to go from one consumer (words demo, one stat strip) to three (dashboard).

lesson: 3440 needed nothing 1280 didn't - same markup, same flex auto + --column:22em split. 1280 already fits wall+table side by side (22em x 2 = 44em floor); 3440 just gives flex-grow more surplus to divide, so the wall shows more card columns and the table's width:100% stretches wider. Measured equal 1035.5px halves of a 2089px region at 3440, headless. No breakpoint written for either width.

bug found + fixed pre-landing: this.text as Filter's query state property collided with View.text() (a getter/setter every View inherits) - this.text ??= "" silently never wrote since a function is never nullish, threw two calls later as this.text.trim is not a function, only visible in a headless console check. Renamed to this.needle everywhere. Filed as a code-skill improvement (View also shadows toggle/show/hide/html, not just render).

verified: cold direct-load of /framework/ux/Filter/doc/decisions/ 404s in the client router - confirmed this is a PRE-EXISTING framework behavior (identical failure on the already-landed /framework/ux/Tree/doc/decisions/), not specific to Filter. Soft navigation (clicking the in-page link from the loaded Filter page) resolves it correctly with zero errors - documentation skill's own advice (verify by clicking through, not loading the doc url cold) confirmed why.
